transformations.carried: exactly one source claim, its text reproduced unchanged (INT-LEDGER-010 when it cites more or changes the text)
transformations.dropped: a ledger entry only (source claims left out, with a meaningful reason); a present synthesized claim marked 'dropped' is INT-LEDGER-009
transformations.generalized: source claims stated more generally (a figure or date left out is INT-LEDGER-024; material content needs a formal entailment check, INT-LEDGER-011)
transformations.merged: two or more source claims combined into one (a figure or date left out is INT-LEDGER-024; material content needs a formal entailment check, INT-LEDGER-011)
transformations.narrowed: a source claim with part of its content left out on purpose (material content needs a coverage check, INT-LEDGER-011)
transformations.new: content no source claim asserts: always INT-LEDGER-005, an error
transformations.paraphrased: one source claim reworded without adding or removing content (a figure or date it leaves out is INT-LEDGER-024)
